scientific_integrity: Proof and finite rational checker are self-contained; finite checks are supporting evidence, not a proof for all real t.
scientific_limitations: Only three identically uniformly distributed values 0,1,t with t>1 and full pairwise independence; only the sharp maximum, not the minimum. No independent validation and historical implicit tabulations not excluded.
title: A sharp upper-coskewness transition for pairwise-independent uniform ternary variables
